info.title: McpIt - ASP.NET Core endpoints to MCP tools
info.description: Offline token-cost analyzer for MCP servers. Reports what your MCP tools/list costs the model, with a CI budget gate. Part of McpIt.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: mcp-token-report - offline MCP tools/list token-cost analyzer

options.name: --markdown
options.description: Render the report as Markdown instead of plain text.

options.name: --budget
options.description:
Fail (exit 1) when the total token cost exceeds N tokens.
Token counts are an OFFLINE heuristic estimate (no network for tokenizing, ~±20%).
